Hotfix for v1.5.5.4 — agent telemetry was silently dropped after Docker discovery landed.

### Fixed

* **Agent telemetry regression** — Docker discover JSON parsing swallowed every agent message, so GPU, host CPU/RAM/disk/bandwidth, container controls (start/stop/restart), and container status badges all stopped updating. URL health checks still ran, which is why cards only showed latency like `2 MS`.
* **Status badges** — show **ONLINE** / **OFFLINE** / **RUNNING** again; latency stays in the tooltip for admins.
* **Apps/Web search toggle** — proper pill styling instead of the broken fieldset look.
* **Settings live preview** — accent color preview reads your saved `--accent-color`, not the hardcoded orange fallback.
* **GPU row layout** — `has-gpu` grid class restored when the agent reports a GPU.

### Install / Upgrade

Proxmox / bare metal:

```bash
curl -sSL https://github.com/boubli/AMUD-Dashboard/releases/latest/download/update-amud.sh | bash
```

Docker / Unraid:

```bash
docker compose pull && docker compose up -d --force-recreate
```

Hard-refresh after upgrade (`Ctrl+Shift+R`). **Settings → System** should show `v1.5.5.5`.

**Skip v1.5.5.4** if you hit missing GPU, dead telemetry widgets, or missing container restart buttons — use v1.5.5.5 or newer.
